name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Exactly two of these are true: Carver goes with Robotics; Ellis goes with Music; Hale goes with Yearbook.
Dunn, Chemistry, and Robotics belong to different classes.
Between Carver and Robotics, one goes with English and the other with Music.
If Yearbook goes with Hale, then either Chemistry does not go with Carver or Rowing goes with Dunn (but not both).
